_comment: Gold facts are quoted verbatim from the extracted text stored by the ingest pipeline (see backend/eval/README). Nothing here was written from memory of the papers; every `source_quote` is a substring of the abstract the pipeline extracted from the pinned arXiv PDF, so factual accuracy is a mechanical containment check rather than a style judgement.

questions.question: How does channel independence work in PatchTST, and what does it buy?

gold_facts.fact: PatchTST segments each series into subseries-level patches used as input tokens.
gold_facts.source_quote: segmentation of time series into subseries-level patches which are served as input tokens to Transformer

gold_facts.fact: Channel independence means each channel holds a single univariate series sharing the same embedding and Transformer weights across all series.
gold_facts.source_quote: channel-independence where each channel contains a single univariate time series that shares the same embedding and Transformer weights across all the series

gold_facts.fact: Patching quadratically reduces computation and memory of attention maps and lets the model attend longer history.
gold_facts.source_quote: computation and memory usage of the attention maps are quadratically reduced given the same look-back window; and the model can attend longer history

gold_facts.fact: PatchTST significantly improves long-term forecasting accuracy over SOTA Transformer-based models.
gold_facts.source_quote: can improve the long-term forecasting accuracy significantly when compared with that of SOTA Transformer-based models

questions.question: Why might Transformers be ineffective for long-term time series forecasting, and what did the authors show instead?

gold_facts.fact: The permutation-invariant self-attention mechanism inevitably results in temporal information loss.
gold_facts.source_quote: the nature of the permutation-invariant self-attention mechanism inevitably results in temporal information loss

gold_facts.fact: A set of simple one-layer linear models named LTSF-Linear outperformed existing Transformer-based LTSF models in all cases on nine datasets.
gold_facts.source_quote: LTSF-Linear surprisingly outperforms existing sophisticated Transformer-based LTSF models in all cases

gold_facts.fact: The experiments used nine real-life datasets.
gold_facts.source_quote: Experimental results on nine real-life datasets

questions.question: What mechanism does Autoformer use instead of self-attention, and what improvement does it report?

gold_facts.fact: Autoformer is a novel decomposition architecture with an Auto-Correlation mechanism.
gold_facts.source_quote: we design Autoformer as a novel decomposition architecture with an Auto-Correlation mechanism

gold_facts.fact: Auto-Correlation discovers dependencies at the sub-series level based on series periodicity.
gold_facts.source_quote: we design the Auto-Correlation mechanism based on the series periodicity, which conducts the dependencies discovery and representation aggregation at the sub-series level

gold_facts.fact: Autoformer yields state-of-the-art accuracy with a 38% relative improvement on six benchmarks.
gold_facts.source_quote: Autoformer yields state-of-the-art accuracy, with a 38% relative improvement on six benchmarks

questions.question: What are the three distinctive characteristics of Informer, and what complexity does ProbSparse attention achieve?

gold_facts.fact: Informer has a ProbSparse self-attention mechanism achieving O(L log L) time and memory.
gold_facts.source_quote: a $ProbSparse$ self-attention mechanism, which achieves $O(L \log L)$ in time complexity and memory usage

gold_facts.fact: A generative style decoder predicts long sequences in one forward operation.
gold_facts.source_quote: the generative style decoder, while conceptually simple, predicts the long time-series sequences at one forward operation

gold_facts.fact: Informer significantly outperforms existing methods on four large-scale datasets.
gold_facts.source_quote: Extensive experiments on four large-scale datasets demonstrate that Informer significantly outperforms existing methods

questions.question: What does iTransformer apply attention to instead of temporal tokens, and what does it achieve?

gold_facts.fact: iTransformer applies attention and feed-forward networks on the inverted dimensions.
gold_facts.source_quote: iTransformer that simply applies the attention and feed-forward network on the inverted dimensions

gold_facts.fact: Time points of individual series are embedded into variate tokens used by the attention mechanism to capture multivariate correlations.
gold_facts.source_quote: the time points of individual series are embedded into variate tokens which are utilized by the attention mechanism to capture multivariate correlations

gold_facts.fact: iTransformer achieves state-of-the-art on challenging real-world datasets.
gold_facts.source_quote: The iTransformer model achieves state-of-the-art on challenging real-world datasets
